blocks.text: The amount to be billed is $16.23.
No packing line is added. Oak plug at one dollar and ninety seven cents is not ticked. Carrier cost is inside the tag, so the gap is not a carrier amount.
The shelf card lists fourteen on hand in the stockroom.
The tag on Linen washcloth, pair was five dollars and twenty five cents.

product.description: The washcloths are linen and sold as a pair.
product.name: Linen washcloth, pair

page.title: Card step for Linen washcloth, pair

trick.instruction: The billed figure is $16.23 and the tag was five dollars and twenty five cents. Refuse the higher figure.
